title: Categories and tags
lead: Names, descriptions and order of Field Manual categories and of news categories and tags in both languages. Internal keys and article assignments stay as they are.
loadFailed: Categories and tags could not be loaded. Try reloading the page.

manual.title: {game} Field Manual – categories
manual.lead: Categories of the public Field Manual. Saved names, descriptions and order take effect in the public manual immediately, in the category overview and in article headers.
manual.caption: {game} Field Manual categories with the number of assigned articles
manual.emptyTitle: The Field Manual has no categories yet
manual.emptyBody: Create the first category; it appears in the public manual once it has a published article.

newsCategories.title: News – categories
newsCategories.lead: Shared news categories for both games and the community. A renamed category shows immediately in the public news filters; the label on an article itself updates when that language version is next published. Order only affects the editor's selector.
newsCategories.caption: News categories with the number of assigned posts
newsCategories.emptyBody: Create the first category; editors can then assign it to posts.

newsTags.title: News – tags
newsTags.lead: Shared news tags. A renamed tag shows immediately in the public news filters; the tags on an article itself update when that language version is next published. Order only affects the editor's selector.
newsTags.caption: News tags with the number of tagged posts
newsTags.emptyBody: Create the first tag; editors can then assign it to posts.

newsDenied.title: News categories and tags are managed by platform-wide editors
newsDenied.body: Your role covers selected games only. News categories and tags are shared by the whole website, so they cannot be edited here.

manualDenied.title: No Field Manual in your scope
manualDenied.body: Field Manual categories can be edited only by editors of a game that has a manual (Hell Let Loose).

semantics.manual-category: The name, description and order take effect in the public Field Manual as soon as they are saved (category overview and article headers). This is not an editorial revision of the articles; every change is written to the audit log.
semantics.news-category: The name shows immediately in the public news list filters once saved. The category label on an article is part of its published revision and updates when that language version is next published. Order only affects the editor's selector. Every change is written to the audit log.
semantics.news-tag: The name shows immediately in the public news list filters once saved. The tags on an article are part of its published revision and update when that language version is next published. Order only affects the editor's selector. Every change is written to the audit log.

form.notFoundBody: There is no category or tag with this address in this section, or it has been deleted.
form.keyHint: Permanent internal identifier: lowercase letters without accents, digits and single hyphens (for example game-modes). It cannot be changed after creation.
form.keyLocked: The key cannot change after creation; articles refer to it.
form.descriptionHintManual: At most 300 characters. Shown on the category card in the public Field Manual.
form.descriptionHintNews: At most 300 characters. Internal note for editors; not shown on the public website.
form.sortOrderHintManual: 0 to 10000; lower numbers appear first in the public manual.
form.sortOrderHintNews: 0 to 10000; lower numbers are offered first in the editor.
form.references: {count, plural, =0 {No assigned articles} one {# assigned article} other {# assigned articles}}
form.conflictTitle: Someone else changed this record meanwhile
form.conflictBody: Your edits are still in the form. Load the current version, compare it and save again.
form.reloaded: The current version is loaded; your unsaved edits stayed in the form.
form.archiveLead: An archived record disappears from the editor's selector, but articles that use it keep it and stay public. Only a record without assigned articles can be deleted; content is never deleted or reassigned automatically.
form.deleteBlocked: {count, plural, one {Deletion is not possible: # article uses this record.} other {Deletion is not possible: # articles use this record.}} Change the category or tags of those articles in the editor first, or archive the record instead.
form.deleteReferenced: The record was assigned to an article meanwhile, so it cannot be deleted. Archive it instead.
form.confirmArchiveBody: {count, plural, =0 {The record disappears from the editor's selector. No article uses it.} one {The record disappears from the editor's selector. The # article that uses it keeps it and stays public.} other {The record disappears from the editor's selector. The # articles that use it keep it and stay public.}}
form.confirmRestoreBody: The record becomes available in the editor's selector again.
form.confirmDeleteBody: No article uses this record. Deletion is permanent; the key {key} can be created again later.

fieldErrors.invalid_key: Use lowercase letters without accents, digits and single hyphens.
fieldErrors.duplicate_key: This key already exists in this section.
